structure: NJSLS-SS 2020 grade-band file for grades 3-5 (end of grade 5). Front matter (intro, mission/vision, framework, practices, structure/coding, essential questions, NJ statutes, references) pp.1-12 identical to the K-2 file. Then 'By End of Grade 5 / Disciplinary Concepts' tables per strand (Civics; Geography; Economics; History) with columns Disciplinary Concept | Description | Core Ideas. Then 'About the NJSLS-SS Eras' (Era 1 Three Worlds Meet to 1620; Era 2 Colonization and Settlement 1585-1763), then Standard 6.1 U.S. History: America in the World by the End of Grade 5 and Standard 6.3 Active Citizenship in the 21st Century by the end of Grade 5, with tables Core Idea | Performance Expectations; PE codes 6.<std>.5.<Strand><Concept>.<n> (e.g. 6.1.5.CivicsPI.1). All grade-level content is the 3-5 band. No courses; no standard 6.2 in this file. Description column cells of the disciplinary concept tables labeled examples (narrative); concept names and core ideas labeled standards.
